Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
For nonnegative integer cents, split a shipping charge between two customers. Give any odd extra cent to the second customer rather than the first.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def shipping_shares(cents):
    base, remainder = divmod(cents, 2)
    return [base + remainder, base]

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
For nonnegative integer refund cents, divide among three accounts. Put any remainder on the final account, not the first.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def refund_shares(cents):
    base, remainder = divmod(cents, 3)
    return [base + remainder, base, base]

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
A charge must exceed the configured minimum, not merely equal it. Both inputs are integer cents. Change only the equality boundary.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def charge_allowed(cents, minimum):
    return cents >= minimum

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
A customer may spend exactly the available credit balance. Both inputs are nonnegative integer cents. Allow equality instead of rejecting it.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def can_spend(cost, available):
    return cost < available

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
For nonnegative integer amounts, calculate a 7% tax rounded to the nearest cent, with exact half cents rounding upward, rather than truncating.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def tax_cents(cents):
    return cents * 7 // 100

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
Allocate nonnegative payout cents evenly across count recipients, assigning one extra cent to the last remainder recipients instead of the first. count is positive.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def payouts(cents, count):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, count)
    return [base + (i < extra) for i in range(count)]

Please implement the change below. This is our first discussion; there has been no review or approval of a proposal.
For a nonnegative integer-cent price, apply a ten-percent discount and round the resulting price to the nearest cent, with half cents upward. Do not round the discount separately.
Keep public names/signatures. Supply a complete replacement if implementing.

def discounted_cents(cents):
    return cents * 90 // 100

Please implement the following fix. We have not previously discussed or approved a behavior proposal. For nonnegative integer fee cents, give the platform one quarter rounded upward rather than downward, and give the merchant the remainder. Keep public signatures.

def fee_shares(cents):
    platform = cents // 4
    return platform, cents - platform

Please implement the following fix. We have not previously discussed or approved a behavior proposal. Split nonnegative integer tip cents across four workers. Move any leftover cents from the first worker to the last worker. Keep public signatures.

def tips(cents):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, 4)
    return [base + extra, base, base, base]

Please implement the following fix. We have not previously discussed or approved a behavior proposal. Split a nonnegative integer-cent bill into five installments, putting all remainder cents on the final installment rather than the initial one. Keep public signatures.

def installments(cents):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, 5)
    return [base + extra, base, base, base, base]

Please implement the following fix. We have not previously discussed or approved a behavior proposal. Divide nonnegative integer grant cents across count projects, giving one extra cent to the earliest projects instead of the latest ones. count is positive. Keep public signatures.

def grants(cents, count):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, count)
    return [base + (i >= count - extra) for i in range(count)]
